selection: Twelve merged, previously unused TypeScript source changes spanning correctness, type behavior, features, localization, and performance. Selection used PR title/body and merge metadata only; no fixing diff was opened before the task artifact was frozen.

cases.issue: Number-format schemas such as ZodInt, ZodFloat32, ZodFloat64, ZodInt32, and ZodUInt32 lose their specific format at the type level. Preserve the concrete format through the core, classic, and mini number-format declarations.

Failed safeParse calls eagerly capture a structured stack when constructing ZodError, dominating failure cost and retained memory. Avoid the eager capture while keeping genuine Error behavior, full stacks on throwing parse paths, and safe fallbacks where the V8 controls are unavailable or frozen.

Object schemas ignore symbol keys declared in their shape. Declared symbols must be validated and preserved across interpreted, JIT, AOT, builder, recursion, and unrepresentable JSON Schema paths without adding work to string-only object parsing.

The object JIT failure path copies every issue merely to prefix its property path, unlike interpreted paths that prefix private issue objects in place. Reuse the safe in-place prefixing behavior and share the emitted template without changing issue ownership.

Top-level parse and codec throwing paths expose internal Zod frames before the user's callsite. Apply the existing best-effort stack trimming consistently to instance, detached, top-level, sync, and async parse, encode, and decode paths.

Local ISO datetime patterns encode the optional timezone suffix by inserting an empty regex-alternation branch, which strict JSON Schema compilers may reject. Express the group as optional while preserving the accepted language for every local and offset flag combination.

Mutually recursive getter options make discriminatedUnion inference collapse because the option constraint resolves each input during the circular call. Preserve inference, reject non-object options, and detect a missing discriminator at construction without invoking recursive getters.

An issue added by superRefine with an explicit input loses that input when it is finalized, so error maps observe the outer payload instead. Preserve an explicitly supplied issue input while retaining the existing fallback for issues that omit it.

Several locale dictionaries describe an invalid IP address as an invalid range. Correct the address wording in the affected Danish, Norwegian, Nynorsk, and Swedish locale messages without changing other issue categories.

Locale format dictionaries have missing mac labels and the Sizable map lacks parity with the runtime format set. Backfill the locale entries and pin dictionary parity so future supported formats cannot silently fall through.
Seven newer locale dictionaries lack the credit_card format label and expose the raw underscored key in user-facing errors. Add vocabulary consistent with each locale's existing number wording.

Schema construction installs enough own properties to push instances out of V8 fast-properties mode, increasing construction and parse cost. Move stable behavior to constructor prototypes while preserving enumeration, lazy caching, assignment, and public schema behavior.
